title: Tangent range of a parametrized regular level set: range D(Φ∘ψ)(v) = DΦ(ψ(v))(ker Dh(ψ(v)))
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ (ℝ^k = EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin k), D = fderiv ℝ), ψ : ℝ^m → ℝ^{m+1}, Φ : ℝ^{m+1} → ℝ^P, h : ℝ^{m+1} → ℝ, V ⊆ ℝ^m open, c > 0 and v ∈ V. Assume ψ is differentiable at v, Φ and h are differentiable at ψ(v), Dh(ψ(v)) ≠ 0, c|v′ − v″| ≤ |ψ(v′) − ψ(v″)| for all v′, v″ ∈ V, and h(ψ(v′)) = h(ψ(v)) for all v′ ∈ V. Then the range of D(Φ∘ψ)(v) equals the image under DΦ(ψ(v)) of the kernel of Dh(ψ(v)): D(Φ∘ψ)(v)(ℝ^m) = DΦ(ψ(v))(ker Dh(ψ(v))).
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (ψ : Eucl m → Eucl (m + 1)) (Φ : Eucl (m + 1) → Eucl P) (h : Eucl (m + 1) → ℝ) (V : Set (Eucl m)) (c : ℝ) (v : Eucl m), IsOpen V → v ∈ V → 0 < c → DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ v → DifferentiableAt ℝ Φ (ψ v) → DifferentiableAt ℝ h (ψ v) → fderiv ℝ h (ψ v) ≠ 0 → (∀ v' ∈ V, ∀ v'' ∈ V, c * ‖v' - v''‖ ≤ ‖ψ v' - ψ v''‖) → (∀ v' ∈ V, h (ψ v') = h (ψ v)) → LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ (Φ ∘ ψ) v).toLinearMap = Submodule.map (fderiv ℝ Φ (ψ v)).toLinearMap (LinearMap.ker (fderiv ℝ h (ψ v)).toLinearMap)
